chapter: Trent's band: Arkansas, Dallas and the Adolphus
title: Holder skims the band's raise and Mosley becomes manager
summary: The hotel gives each man a $25 raise that Holder pockets until Trent asks; Mosley takes over as manager.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Well Tiola went down with us.
OH, TIOLA WENT DOWN WITH YOU.
HE TOOK (INAUDIBLE) PLACE. DID THEY KNOW ABOUT HIM, WAS HE WORKING AROUND OR WHAT, WHO KNEW ABOUT HIM, I GUESS TRENT KNEW ABOUT HIM.
I guess Trent knew about him.
YOU DIDN'T KNOW HIM. YOU NEVER HEARD ABOUT HIM. WAS HE AS GOOD AS THEY SAID HE WAS.
He was a good man. He could play. Beautiful tone, and he could play. But he was a crook. That's how he lost his own band.
I KNOW ABOUT HIS OWN BAND.

Well that's how he lost. You seen when we went in the Adolphis, everybody, it was like a co-op band, every got the same amount, Trent and everybody. It was a fantastic salary in those days, $50 a band. That was fantastic money. Well, after we had been at the Adolphis for three months, they appreciated that we drew so many people and did so well that Mr. E. unbeknownst to us, we didn't know this, we didn't know he gave us $25 a piece raise.
But we weren't making it, Holder was the manager.

OH HOLDER WAS THE MANAGER.
Holder was the manager. He used to go down and collect the money. So for at least almost six months, over five months he was getting all this extra money, now we noticed a fool and his money. He came up with this new car and we said oh, where did he go and get this brand new Buick. At that time the Buicks went back to Packard, it was a gorgeous thing. So we became suspicious and we said to Trent well you had better go down and see what's happening down there, maybe the Adolphis has given us a raise. Sure enough, the way Trent did, he went and spoke to Mr. E. and said Mr. E. I think it's about time for us to have a raise. He didn't really know that Holder didn't pay us. So he said, well I just gave you a raise four or five months ago. And Trent was flabbergasted. Then he said we haven't received any raise, we're still getting the same $50 that we got when we came in here. He said after you boys have been in here three months, I gave Holder $25 for each of you in the band, we should have been getting $75.
Well, anyway that's when he stopped manager.
YOU KEPT HIM IN THE BAND THOUGH. DID TRENT HANDLE THE MONEY FROM THAT TIME ON.
I didn't get a chance to steal anything. They kept a rein on everybody.
